description: This file defines an emoji suggestion provider component for a chat application, handling emoji and emoticon autocomplete logic, including rendering suggestions and matching emojis based on user input.

classes.name: EmoticonProvider
classes.description: A class extending Provider that manages emoji and emoticon suggestions based on user input.

methods.name: handlePretextChanged
methods.description: Processes user input to detect potential emoji or emoticon triggers and initiates suggestion fetching.

methods.name: formatEmojis
methods.description: Formats a list of EmojiItems into display strings, converting system emojis to Unicode.

methods.name: findAndSuggestEmojis
methods.description: Searches for matching emojis based on partial input and invokes the results callback with suggestions.
